thesis: A controlled MVP must prove useful representation, discovery, qualification, invitations and privacy before broad automation.
role: Specify modules, authority separation and outcome evaluation.

ideas.statement: Vault, intent builder, opportunity analysis, discovery, controlled engagement, qualification, decision support and audit form the initial product, excluding feeds and autonomous contracts.
Logical agent roles enforce least privilege and organizational authority; source prose and structured intent remain linked for correction.
Existing lawful connectors, email and guest access bridge adoption; human operations transparently teach the system before automation expands.
Both sides must judge qualified conversations against attention, complaints, corrections and later collaboration; relevance benchmarks alone are insufficient.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: External documents cannot authorize actions, credentials require actual verification, and a central operational MVP must preserve separation and future interoperability.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
